--- file:///.src/acquireReleaseDisposable.ts ---
// @effect-v4
/// <reference lib="esnext.disposable" />
import { Effect } from "effect"
import { acquireRelease } from "effect/Effect"

declare const acquireSync: Effect.Effect<Disposable>
declare const acquireAsync: Effect.Effect<AsyncDisposable>

// Should trigger for the synchronous disposal protocol.
export const syncDisposable = Effect.acquireDisposable(acquireSync)

// Should trigger for the asynchronous disposal protocol with an unused exit.
export const asyncDisposable = Effect.acquireRelease(
  acquireAsync,
  function(resource, _exit) {
    return Effect.promise(function() {
      return resource[Symbol.asyncDispose]()
    })
  }
)

// Should trigger through an Effect namespace alias.
const Fx = Effect
export const aliasedModule = Fx.acquireRelease(
  acquireSync,
  (resource) => Fx.sync(() => resource[Symbol.dispose]())
)

// Should diagnose a named import, but the quick fix cannot safely rewrite its import.
export const namedImport = acquireRelease(
  acquireAsync,
  (resource) => Effect.promise(async () => resource[Symbol.asyncDispose]())
)

declare const acquireBoth: Effect.Effect<Disposable | (Disposable & AsyncDisposable)>
export const disposableUnion = Effect.acquireRelease(
  acquireBoth,
  (resource) => Effect.sync(() => resource[Symbol.dispose]())
)

// Should not trigger when a named method happens to implement the protocol.
interface ManagedLike extends AsyncDisposable {
  dispose(): Promise<void>
}
declare const acquireManaged: Effect.Effect<ManagedLike>
export const namedDispose = Effect.acquireRelease(
  acquireManaged,
  (resource) => Effect.promise(() => resource.dispose())
)

// Should not trigger for a named cleanup method without a disposal protocol.
declare const acquireCloseable: Effect.Effect<{ close(): void }>
export const namedClose = Effect.acquireRelease(
  acquireCloseable,
  (resource) => Effect.sync(() => resource.close())
)

// Should not trigger when the release contains extra behavior.
export const extraCleanup = Effect.acquireRelease(
  acquireSync,
  (resource) => Effect.sync(() => {
    resource[Symbol.dispose]()
    console.log("disposed")
  })
)

// Should not trigger when the release depends on the exit.
export const exitAware = Effect.acquireRelease(
  acquireSync,
  (resource, exit) => Effect.sync(() => {
    console.log(exit)
    resource[Symbol.dispose]()
  })
)

// Should not trigger when the wrappers do not implement the protocol correctly.
export const unawaitedAsyncDispose = Effect.acquireRelease(
  acquireAsync,
  (resource) => Effect.sync(() => resource[Symbol.asyncDispose]())
)

// Should not trigger when acquireRelease options carry extra semantics.
export const interruptible = Effect.acquireRelease(
  acquireSync,
  (resource) => Effect.sync(() => resource[Symbol.dispose]()),
  { interruptible: true }
)

// Should not trigger for imprecise success types.
declare const acquireAny: Effect.Effect<any>
export const imprecise = Effect.acquireRelease(
  acquireAny,
  (resource) => Effect.sync(() => resource[Symbol.dispose]())
)

// Should not trigger for an unrelated API with the same shape.
const unrelated = {
  acquireRelease: <A>(acquire: Effect.Effect<A>, release: (value: A) => Effect.Effect<unknown>) =>
    Effect.acquireRelease(acquire, release)
}
export const unrelatedCall = unrelated.acquireRelease(
  acquireSync,
  (resource) => Effect.sync(() => resource[Symbol.dispose]())
)

  acquireSync,

  acquireAsync,

  acquireAsync,

    console.log("disposed")
  })

  acquireSync,
  (resource, exit) => Effect.sync(() => {

// @effect-v4
/// <reference lib="esnext.disposable" />
import { Effect } from "effect"
import { acquireRelease } from "effect/Effect"

declare const acquireSync: Effect.Effect<Disposable>
declare const acquireAsync: Effect.Effect<AsyncDisposable>

// Should trigger for the synchronous disposal protocol.
export const syncDisposable = Effect.acquireRelease(
  acquireSync,
  (resource) => Effect.sync(() => resource[Symbol.dispose]())
)

// Should trigger for the asynchronous disposal protocol with an unused exit.
export const asyncDisposable = Effect.acquireRelease(
  acquireAsync,
  function(resource, _exit) {
    return Effect.promise(function() {
      return resource[Symbol.asyncDispose]()
    })
  }
)

// Should trigger through an Effect namespace alias.
const Fx = Effect
export const aliasedModule = Fx.acquireRelease(
  acquireSync,
  (resource) => Fx.sync(() => resource[Symbol.dispose]())
)

// Should diagnose a named import, but the quick fix cannot safely rewrite its import.
export const namedImport = acquireRelease(
  acquireAsync,
  (resource) => Effect.promise(async () => resource[Symbol.asyncDispose]())
)

declare const acquireBoth: Effect.Effect<Disposable | (Disposable & AsyncDisposable)>
export const disposableUnion = Effect.acquireDisposable(acquireBoth)

// Should not trigger when a named method happens to implement the protocol.
interface ManagedLike extends AsyncDisposable {
  dispose(): Promise<void>
}
declare const acquireManaged: Effect.Effect<ManagedLike>
export const namedDispose = Effect.acquireRelease(
  acquireManaged,
  (resource) => Effect.promise(() => resource.dispose())
)

// Should not trigger for a named cleanup method without a disposal protocol.
declare const acquireCloseable: Effect.Effect<{ close(): void }>
export const namedClose = Effect.acquireRelease(
  acquireCloseable,
  (resource) => Effect.sync(() => resource.close())
)

// Should not trigger when the release contains extra behavior.
export const extraCleanup = Effect.acquireRelease(
  acquireSync,
  (resource) => Effect.sync(() => {
    resource[Symbol.dispose]()
    console.log("disposed")
  })
)

// Should not trigger when the release depends on the exit.
export const exitAware = Effect.acquireRelease(
  acquireSync,
  (resource, exit) => Effect.sync(() => {
    console.log(exit)
    resource[Symbol.dispose]()
  })
)

// Should not trigger when the wrappers do not implement the protocol correctly.
export const unawaitedAsyncDispose = Effect.acquireRelease(
  acquireAsync,
  (resource) => Effect.sync(() => resource[Symbol.asyncDispose]())
)

// Should not trigger when acquireRelease options carry extra semantics.
export const interruptible = Effect.acquireRelease(
  acquireSync,
  (resource) => Effect.sync(() => resource[Symbol.dispose]()),
  { interruptible: true }
)

// Should not trigger for imprecise success types.
declare const acquireAny: Effect.Effect<any>
export const imprecise = Effect.acquireRelease(
  acquireAny,
  (resource) => Effect.sync(() => resource[Symbol.dispose]())
)

// Should not trigger for an unrelated API with the same shape.
const unrelated = {
  acquireRelease: <A>(acquire: Effect.Effect<A>, release: (value: A) => Effect.Effect<unknown>) =>
    Effect.acquireRelease(acquire, release)
}
export const unrelatedCall = unrelated.acquireRelease(
  acquireSync,
  (resource) => Effect.sync(() => resource[Symbol.dispose]())
)
